title: QuadrantTaskBoard 四象限任务看板
description: 基于四象限矩阵（如艾森豪威尔矩阵）的任务看板：点击象限标题上的 +（或象限的空白区域）添加任务，活动任务上的紧凑编辑和删除按钮（React 中位于任务卡片内、名称旁边）可编辑或删除任务，在 + 按钮或任务旁直接弹出的面板用于填写任务名称并选择象限，删除前会就地确认；任务可通过拖放或 Shift + 方向键移动（双击即可编辑）。看板是受控的：通过 points 传入任务，并把 onPointsChange 收到的新列表回传。它还接受 QuadrantChart 的其他属性（坐标轴、象限标题、徽标和颜色、刻度、标签……），内置按钮和面板会跟随应用语言。由 minerva-design 导出，而非 minerva-design/charts。

props.name: labels
props.description: Texts of the buttons and panels (localized by default)

props.name: draggable
props.description: Lets the user drag the dots (`drag` / `drop` events)

props.name: name
props.description: Name of the points in the tooltip

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; shown by default when several series have a name

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels

props.name: renderTooltip
props.description: React content of the card of the active point, in place of its name and quadrant (the engine tooltip is not shown)

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the data layer: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D

props.name: crosshair
props.description: Vertical guide line following the pointer

props.name: annotations
props.description: Background areas and reference lines

props.name: interaction
props.description: Zoom (Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel, pinch), pan (drag), double-click reset and keyboard navigation; `false` makes the chart static

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the plot area, in pixels

props.name: palette
props.description: Series colors (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale of the texts and numbers the chart writes (tooltip rows, compact units `k` / `万`, separators, month and weekday names of time axes)

props.name: quadrantContent
props.description: React content placed over each quadrant (e.g. an add button); the content receives pointer events, the rest of the quadrant does not

props.name: accessiblePoints
props.description: Visually hidden list of buttons per quadrant so keyboard and screen reader users can reach the dots: Enter / Space calls `onPointClick`, Shift + arrow keys move the point to the next quadrant (`onPointDrop` with the center of that quadrant); the focused dot gets a focus ring

props.name: getPointProps
props.typeText: ((point: QuadrantPoint, index: number) => Record<string, string | number | boolean | undefined>) | undefined
props.description: Extra attributes of the invisible anchor placed on each dot (e.g. `data-testid`); every anchor already has `data-point-index` and `data-label` and the class `minerva-chart-quadrant-point`

props.name: points
props.description: Points to place

props.name: xDomain
props.description: Range of the horizontal axis

props.name: yDomain
props.description: Range of the vertical axis

props.name: xSplit
props.description: X value of the vertical divider (the middle of `xDomain` by default)

props.name: ySplit
props.description: Y value of the horizontal divider (the middle of `yDomain` by default)

props.name: quadrants
props.description: Titles and colors of the quadrants

props.name: xLabel
props.description: Title of the horizontal axis

props.name: yLabel
props.description: Title of the vertical axis

props.name: axisLabels
props.description: Texts at the ends of the dividers, drawn inside the plot (e.g. "Important" at the top)

props.name: showTicks
props.description: Shows the numeric ticks of the axes; `false` keeps only the matrix

props.name: reverseX
props.description: Reverses the horizontal axis (e.g. "urgent" on the left)

props.name: showLabels
props.description: Draws the labels next to the dots (overlapping labels are skipped)

props.name: pointSize
props.description: Dot diameter in pixels

props.name: showCounts
props.typeText: boolean | ((count: number, points: readonly QuadrantPoint[]) => string) | undefined
props.description: Shows the number of points of each quadrant after its title; a function returns the text instead (e.g. `(n) => `${n} tasks``)

props.name: selectedIndex
props.description: Index of the selected point: drawn with a ring of its color (`null`: none)

props.name: selectedIndices
props.description: Indices of the selected points (several selected points)

events.name: onPointsChange
events.description: Called with the next list of tasks after an add, an edit, a delete, a drag and drop or a keyboard move (controlled: pass them back as `points`)

events.name: onPointClick
events.description: Called with the clicked point and its index

events.name: onHover
events.description: Called when the hovered (or keyboard-focused) points change

events.name: onZoom
events.description: Called when the user zooms or pans

events.name: onRendererChange
events.description: Called with the backend once it is ready (and when it falls back after a GPU loss)

events.name: onPointDrag
events.typeText: ((point: QuadrantPoint, index: number, target: QuadrantDropTarget) => void) | undefined
events.description: Called on every move of a dragged point, with the quadrant under the pointer. A local visual preview follows every move; commit `points` in `onPointDrop` (cancellation leaves caller data unchanged)

roadmap.aria: 按投入和影响排列的路线图
roadmap.name: 功能名称

QuadrantTaskBoardProps.onPointsChange: 在添加、编辑、删除、拖放或键盘移动任务后调用，参数为新的任务列表（受控：将其作为 points 回传）
QuadrantTaskBoardProps.labels: 按钮和面板的文案（见 QuadrantTaskLabels）；未提供的项跟随语言设置

QuadrantTaskLabels.add: 每个象限的添加按钮，以及添加面板的标题
QuadrantTaskLabels.edit: 活动任务的编辑按钮，以及编辑面板的标题
QuadrantTaskLabels.delete: 活动任务的删除按钮，以及删除确认框的标题
QuadrantTaskLabels.deleteConfirm: 删除确认的文案；{name} 会被替换为任务名称
QuadrantTaskLabels.name: 名称字段的标签
QuadrantTaskLabels.save: 添加 / 编辑面板的保存按钮
QuadrantTaskLabels.actions: 活动任务工具栏的无障碍名称

QuadrantConfig.points: 任务 { x, y, label, color, size }：受控列表，通过 onPointsChange 更新
QuadrantConfig.xSplit: 竖直分隔线的 X 值（默认为 xDomain 中点）
QuadrantConfig.ySplit: 水平分隔线的 Y 值（默认为 yDomain 中点）
QuadrantConfig.quadrants: 各象限的标题、徽标和颜色；未设置标题的象限显示本地化的默认标题
QuadrantConfig.axisLabels: 分隔线两端的文字，绘制在绘图区内（如顶部的“重要”）
QuadrantConfig.showTicks: 显示坐标轴的数值刻度；false 时只保留矩阵
QuadrantConfig.reverseX: 反转横轴（如将紧急放在左侧）
QuadrantConfig.showLabels: 在点旁绘制任务名称，跳过重叠项
QuadrantConfig.name: 提示框中任务的名称
QuadrantConfig.draggable: 允许用户把任务拖到其他象限（看板默认开启；设为 false 关闭）
QuadrantConfig.showCounts: 在每个象限标题后显示任务数（看板默认开启；false 隐藏，传入函数 (count, points) 则返回自定义文本）
QuadrantConfig.selectedIndex: 选中任务的索引，用圆环标出（null：无）；默认由看板选中最近一次点击、移动或保存的任务
QuadrantConfig.selectedIndices: 多个选中任务的索引，各自用圆环标出

native_QuadrantTaskBoardProps.onPointsChange: 在添加、编辑、删除、拖放任务或执行“移到”无障碍操作后调用，参数为新的任务列表（受控：将其作为 points 回传）
native_QuadrantTaskBoardProps.labels: 按钮和面板的文案（add、edit、delete、deleteConfirm、confirmDelete、name、quadrant、save、cancel、actions）；未提供的项跟随语言设置

cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-header-color: 象限标题的文字颜色（默认为 --text-color）
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-header-background: 象限标题区的背景（默认为半透明表面色）
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-count-background: 任务计数标签的背景（默认为 --surface-muted-color）
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-count-color: 任务计数标签的文字颜色（默认为 --text-secondary-color）
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-actions-background: 活动任务工具栏的背景（默认为 --surface-elevated-color）
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-actions-radius: 活动任务工具栏的圆角（默认为 --radius-md）
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-panel-background: 就地添加 / 编辑 / 删除面板的背景（默认为半透明的浮层表面）
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-panel-border: 面板的边框颜色（默认为半透明的 --border-color）

native.limitations: 在 React Native 中，任务通过拖放或读屏软件的“移到”操作移动：不支持 Shift + 方向键移动，也不支持双击编辑（请使用活动任务的编辑按钮）。按钮图标由 View 绘制，无需依赖 SVG。

basic.title: 艾森豪威尔看板
basic.description: 点按 + 或象限的空白区域添加任务，点按任务显示编辑和删除按钮，把任务拖到其他象限即可移动。示例任务名称会跟随应用语言，重命名后则保持不变。

basic.title: 艾森豪威尔看板
basic.description: points、quadrants 和 axisLabels 作为属性设置，reverse-x、hide-ticks 和 height 作为特性设置；minerva-points-change 监听器把新列表回写到 points。

props.points: 任务 { x, y, label, color, size }；把 minerva-points-change 的 detail 回写即可更新看板（受控）；仅作为属性设置
props.quadrants: 各象限的标题、徽标和颜色（topLeft、topRight、bottomLeft、bottomRight）；仅作为属性设置
props.axisLabels: 分隔线两端的文字，绘制在绘图区内（top、bottom、left、right）；仅作为属性设置
props.xDomain: 横轴的范围（默认 [0, 10]）；仅作为属性设置
props.yDomain: 纵轴的范围（默认 [0, 10]）；仅作为属性设置
props.hideTicks: 隐藏坐标轴的数值刻度（只保留矩阵）
props.hideLabels: 隐藏点旁边的任务名称
props.hideCounts: 隐藏象限标题中的任务数
props.height: 图表高度：像素值或任意 CSS 长度（默认 320）
props.locale: 内置文案、默认象限标题和数字所用的语言（如 "fr"）；默认跟随组件库语言
props.noAccessiblePoints: 不渲染视觉隐藏的任务列表（键盘和读屏访问、Shift + 方向键移动）
props.options: 图表的其他引擎选项（图例、提示框、内边距、调色板……）；仅作为属性设置

events.minerva-points-change: 任务发生变化（添加、编辑、删除、拖放、键盘移动）；detail：{ points }，即要回写到 points 的新列表
events.minerva-point-click: 点击了一个任务（它会成为选中任务）；detail：{ point, index }
events.minerva-point-drag: 正在拖动一个任务（每次移动都会触发）；detail：{ point, index, x, y, quadrant }
events.minerva-hover: 悬停（或键盘聚焦）的任务发生变化；detail：{ x, xLabel, items }，无悬停时为 null
events.minerva-zoom: 用户对图表进行了缩放或平移；detail：{ x, y }（可见范围）
events.minerva-renderer-change: 图表渲染后端已就绪，或在 GPU 丢失后回退；detail：{ renderer }
